learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the psychological paralysis of a young woman caught between a hard, familiar past and the terrifying promise of freedom in a new world!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: लकवा / निर्णय न ले पाने की स्थिति

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Set in Dublin, the story explores emotional and psychological paralysis. Eveline is miserable at home but finds herself psychologically unable to move forward or make a life-changing choice.
Before dying, Eveline's mother made her promise to keep the family together. This promise, along with fear of her abusive father, acts as an anchor tying her to a life of drudgery.
Frank, a kind sailor, represents escape, romance, and a fresh start in Buenos Ayres. He offers Eveline a chance to live rather than just survive.
At the North Wall docks, gripped by panic and terror of the unknown, Eveline freezes. She clutches the barrier, looking at Frank like a 'helpless animal,' unable to board the ship.

fun_activity.title: ⚖️ Eveline's Balance Sheet
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a T-chart on paper. On the left, list all the reasons Eveline should STAY in Dublin. On the right, list reasons she should GO to Argentina with Frank. Which side genuinely has more weight?

exam_tips: 📌 Pay close attention to the sound of the street organ—it reminds Eveline of the night her mother died and triggers her sudden impulse to escape.
📌 Contrast the character of the Father (oppressive, threatening, demanding) with Frank (warm, adventurous, supportive).
📌 Explain the significance of dust in the story: it symbolizes stagnation, decay, and the unchanging nature of her Dublin life.
quick_recap: ⭐ Eveline is nineteen years old and works hard at a stores and taking care of her household.
⭐ Her father forbade her from seeing Frank because he mistrusted sailors.
⭐ The ending is a powerful tragic anti-climax: she chooses familiar suffering over uncertain freedom.
